title: Universal Life Insurance Loan Service Terms: Cash Settlement of Loan Interest
content:
## Terms

Loan interest on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy loan that the owner settles in cash before it falls due is settled as a single interest payment on the policy. A cash settlement moves the policy's loan interest paid-to date to the settlement date without reducing loan principal: the loan balance is unchanged, and interest is next counted from the new paid-to date.

| Element | Effect of a cash settlement of loan interest |
|---|---|
| Who pays | The owner, in cash |
| When | Before the interest falls due |
| Loan interest paid-to date | Moves to the settlement date |
| Loan principal | Not reduced |
| Activity history | Shows the interest payment as a loan repayment entry that repays no principal |

## Settlement tool: `settle_loan_interest_b95e2dd6`

**Capability.** Records the owner's cash settlement of the loan interest accrued on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy loan. One call books one loan-repayment entry in the policy's activity history that pays interest only (principal repaid 0.00, interest paid as given, paid by online bank payment on today's date) and moves the policy's loan interest paid-to date to today. The loan balance is not changed.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ul_policy_id` | The reference number of the universal life policy whose loan interest is being settled, read from the universal life policy lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `interest_amount` | The loan interest the owner pays in cash | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent; greater than zero |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `ul_txn_id` (the reference number of the new interest payment entry), `ul_policy_id` (the policy), `interest_amount` (the interest booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `loan_interest_paid_to_date` (the new paid-to date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which reads `interest_settled` when the entry was booked. No other return is defined.

## Questions answered

**Does the settlement lower the loan?** No. Only interest is paid; the loan balance stays as it was.

**What does the policy show afterwards? (hypothetical)** A policy whose loan interest paid-to date was 10 March and on which interest is settled on 22 August shows a paid-to date of 22 August and, in its activity history, an interest payment dated 22 August repaying no principal.
